units: <cite ref="Menachot 86a:29">Men. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>שמן זית מִזֵּיתוֹ</he> ‘olive-oil’ (<cite ref="Exodus 27:20">Ex. XXVII, 20</cite>) that means of that which flows of itself (before pressing).

senses.gloss: olive; (sub. עץ) olive tree. Ib. בראש הז׳, v. גִּרְגֵּר; a. v. fr.—כַּזַּ׳ the size of an olive; כחצי ז׳ half the size of &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:1">Bets. I, 1</cite> <he>זה וזה בכז׳</he> the legal size for both is that of &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 57a:8">Ber. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>הרואה ז׳ וכ׳</he> one who dreams of olives.

<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 3:9">Ḥall. III, 9</cite> <he>זֵיתֵי מסיק</he>, v. <cite ref="M01927"><he>מָסִיק</he></cite>; a. fr.—Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Ki Thetsé 10 <he>כַּזֵּ׳ כַּזֵּ׳</he> in pieces of olive-sizes; Pesik. Zakh., p. 25ᵇ <he>ז׳ ז׳</he>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite>.—
